Mushrooms and Schizophrenia
Hello this is my Golden teachers mushroom trip. To give A little detail of my experience with drugs, I have previously smoked marijuana for ten years (I havent in 8 months). I have tried many other drugs, but am currently sober. As of mushrooms I have had 3 previous mushroom trips in my life and this is will be my 4th. The reason that I decided to try mushrooms is to have a better understanding of my schizophrenia and in search of spiritual exploration.
8:30pm:
I am in A stable and calm mindset. I am feelinh ready for the experience. I ate about 1.5 g of golden teacher mushrooms
After eating I feel oddly comfortable and at peace. I feel warm even just a couple minutes afterword.
After eating I feel oddly comfortable and at peace. I feel warm even just a couple minutes afterword.
I am listening to dermot kennedy - Outnumbered.
8:50pm:
I ate the other .5 grams
Within the next 20 minutes my body started to feel very heavy (almost like A very strong body high from weed) that made it hard to walk. I had to sit down. I felt A large amount of preasure around my body. It honestly felt like I was dying but I knew it was because of the mushrooms.
An hour later at about 9:50pm I realized that I could feel the energy or entity that was causing my disorder (Schizophrenia) and memory loss.
It was like an invisible energy.
I could sense my thoughts and bodily. Processes. This invisible energy was surrounding me and blocking the creation of thoughts by creating mental blockages. I than lost track of time walking home. I returned home at around 12pm. [12am?]
I was then hearing voices, but I felt like they were real. I think it was an effect of the mushrooms. Within the next hour or so I started to hear  20 or so different voices. It was like they were outside talking. It was very unorganized voices and were speaking in an undisorderly fashion.
I heard voices crying and worrying that I was very far away and talking about me not understanding whats going on or saying that I have no clue.
I heard some voices saying that they love me.
I heard voices coughing and asking for cigerettes.
I also heard sponge bob.
I then decided to get some sleep.
I found it difficult to sleep and was up till 3-4 am.
What I have experienced was very similar to the states of psychosis that I have had while in states of schizophrenia. It was definetly An important realization that has taught me pivotal information about my illness. I was prepared to have an ALTARED MINDSTATE.
